title: 世界杯没带来就业：反而，减少了？
speaker: Anna Wong

segments.en: And then the place that's really weak is leisure and hospitality. And that is due to the reversal of the world cup hiring.
segments.zh: 真正疲软的是休闲和酒店业，这是由于世界杯招聘的反转。

segments.en: But here, even here, I think it's pretty alarming. So originally, it was supposed to be not alarming because in spring, we saw that there was a huge increase in hiring for leisure and hospitality.
segments.zh: 但即使在这里，我认为也相当令人担忧。原本不应该如此，因为春季我们看到休闲和酒店业招聘大幅增加。

segments.en: But in today's report, we also see a massive downward revisions to the last two months, job print.
segments.zh: 但在今天的报告中，我们看到前两个月的就业数据被大幅下修。

segments.en: And a lot of it came from leisure and hospitality sector.
segments.zh: 其中很大一部分来自休闲和酒店业。

segments.en: You know, while we thought that in April and May, that was a huge increase in hiring in hotels and food and restaurants, it actually didn't happen or it's a very mild kind of increase.
segments.zh: 我们原本以为4月和5月酒店、餐饮业招聘大幅增加，但实际上并没有发生，或者只是非常温和的增长。

segments.en: And now, with this last two months, so July and June's negative, large, negative prints in leisure and hospitality, it basically means that on that, it's cutting down leisure and hospitality level of employment from even before the world cup.
segments.zh: 现在，最近两个月，即7月和6月休闲和酒店业的负增长，基本上意味着该行业的就业水平甚至低于世界杯之前。

segments.en: So I think that's also pretty weak.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这也是相当疲软的。
